name: Flourless Chocolate Lava Cakes

instructions.primary_message: Adjust oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 190°C (375°F). Butter seven 113 g ramekins (see notes).
Using a microwave or a bowl set over a pan of simmering water, melt chocolate with butter, stirring occasionally, until melted and smooth. Remove from heat.
While chocolate is melting, whip eggs, sugar, and salt using a mixer fitted with a whip attachment on medium-high speed until mixture is lightened and pale in color, about 5 minutes.

Reduce speed to low and mix in chocolate mixture until combined. Spoon into cups and place on baking sheet. Bake until edges are set but center is underdone, about 10 minutes. Avoid over-baking. Let cool 3 minutes and serve.

schema_metadata.keywords: cake, chocoholic, chocolate, flourless, gluten free, lava cake

description: Little pots of satiny molten chocolate are the ultimate fix for chocoholics in under 30 minutes.
notes: Notes: I used paper baking cups which held 7 tablespoons of batter. Either 113 g or 170 g ramekins will also work. If using 170 g ramekins, divide batter between six ramekins instead of seven and increase bake time by 2 minutes. The Interior of the cake, while still gooey, should register 70°C (160°F) when it comes out of the oven.
author: Yvonne Ruperti
